name: devops-kubernetes-for-data
description: Use when the user asks about Spark on Kubernetes, the Spark Operator, Airflow KubernetesExecutor, Kafka on Kubernetes with Strimzi, Volcano or Kueue batch scheduling, GPU scheduling, node pools or Karpenter for data jobs, or storage for data workloads. Produces data-platform configs on Kubernetes. Not for pipeline design (use data-etl-pipeline).
